name: Pashur
bio: Pashur son of Malchiah (also spelled Melchiah) was sent by King Zedekiah, along with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, to ask Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD during the Babylonian siege, receiving only a grim answer of coming judgment (Jeremiah 21:1-10). Later, he joined other officials in urging Zedekiah to put Jeremiah to death for discouraging the defenders, leading to his imprisonment in a cistern (Jeremiah 38:1-6). He is a different figure from Pashur son of Immer, who had earlier beaten Jeremiah.
